args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 1 flagged, 7 cleared.
Flagged: r03 (width_free_ratio_used). Its largest flank difference is -7.97 %/h at 432 µm, against a batch median of 0.495 %/h. The sign is reversed and it is about 16 times larger. Because it used the width-free ratio, plane sections was not run, so no final check tested this curvature-rate signal. Its centre strain-rate peak (REGR) is 53.02 %/h at 421 µm and its growth zone is 695 µm, both in line with the batch.
Cleared: r01, r05, r08 (no remedies; every summary close to the batch median; all checks pass). r02 (width-free ratio of -0.04; otherwise identical to r01). r06 and r07 (all checks pass, including plane sections, which supports their flank difference near the tip at 21 µm). r04 (width-free ratio; its large z values come from a very small batch MAD: growth zone 21 µm shorter, about 3%, and a flank difference of -0.81 %/h, about the batch's size with the opposite sign; rigid-body invariance and closure pass).
What the flagged run has in common with the batch: it is the only run where the width-free ratio left a large curvature-rate signal, the flank difference, untested by any check. Its velocity and centre strain-rate profile match the other roots.
